summary: Llama-modchip is a lightweight Llama inference implementation that runs on 64 GB of RAM without a GPU, using a custom modchip technique. It is built in Python and offers both a CLI and a Python API, but lacks a PyPI distribution. The tool is suited for developers who need CPU‑only inference on large RAM machines. It stands out for its GPU‑free approach yet trails major alternatives in adoption and performance evidence, and its test suite shows major functionality gaps.

github.description: 🐋 Run 284B DeepSeek-V4-Flash (<59GiB RAM, 44.4 tok/s pp, 9.1-14.7 tok/s) & 30B MoEs (25-111 tok/s) on a pure 64GB CPU at 256K ctx (0 GPUs). SwiGLU-H2, Stockfish-PVS L3 & 13ms Claude Code restore.
